proves.claim: With items.barRulesAtAdd on, a pass-with-no-tests check naming a test file absent from main is refused CHECK_PASSES_EMPTY naming the test -f fix.

cli.io-item-bar-empty-check.refused.why: Without it add filed a check that was green before any work existed and proved nothing.

proves.claim: A guarded check, one without the flag, a test file on main, --accept-green and the setting off are accepted.

cli.io-item-bar-empty-check.allowed.why: Without it legal checks would be refused at add.

proves.claim: The real add command refuses CHECK_PASSES_EMPTY with the setting on.

cli.io-item-bar-empty-check.real-add.why: Without it the rule could pass its unit cases while add never called it.
